author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Waterproofing makes or breaks showers. On this project I’m combining two 12 by 12 Schluter LED niches into one. I bond them together with KERDI-FIX and smooth the excess with a plastic knife. Then I waterproof that seam with one piece of 5-inch KERDI-BAND. I use the two KERDI frames to waterproof the perimeter and overlap by 2 inches. Now this shower niche is 100% waterproof and can be tiled
title: Custom Schluter Shower Niche Waterproofing Tips - #showerremodel #schlutersystems #sponsored
